description:
Rogue Planets
New kinds of worlds, over thirty new market conditions, and a frontier that keeps a few secrets.

Download RoguePlanets-1.0.0.zip
Release page and later versions
Version 1.0.0 | Starsector 0.98.5a | No other mods required | Requires a new game

Rogue Planets is built around exploration. This post shows a little of what's out there and leaves the rest for you to find.

New worlds
Six new planet types turn up across the frontier. A few other worlds exist only once in each sector, and I'm not showing you those.

Nocturnal
Dark rogue worlds
drifting at the cold
edges of systems.

Halite
The salt-crusted bed
of a vanished ocean.

Chthonian
The bare metal core
of a gas giant its
star stripped away.

Sub-Brown Dwarf
A super-Jupiter that
never quite became
a star.

Snowball
An ocean world
frozen pole to pole.

Sundered
A world broken apart,
circled by its own
tumbling crust.

Market conditions
Over thirty new conditions are scattered across non-core worlds. Some are simple boons or burdens. Many are synergies.

The synergy system
A synergy condition lies dormant until you build the right pair of industries on that world. With both running, it switches on: missile batteries that join your battles, garrisons dug into a volcano, an observatory that maps the sector for you. Let either industry be disrupted and the bonus goes quiet. A few conditions punish you for it.

Hover any condition on a planet to see its full rules and which industries it needs.

And something else
Some of what's out there isn't on any chart. Keep exploring.

Installation

Extract the zip into Starsector/mods/ so you have Starsector/mods/RoguePlanets/.
Enable Rogue Planets in the launcher.
Start a new campaign. Worlds and conditions are generated when a sector is created.

Compatibility

Starsector 0.98.5a.
Requires a new game. Adding it to an existing save won't generate the new worlds.
Not safe to remove from a save that has used it.
Tested alongside Nexerelin (AI colonies can settle these worlds) Unknown Skies, and Industrial Evolution.
Synergy Conditions may or may not work with mods that modify the ID of a base-game industry type (Feel free to comment and let me know which mods I can put a fix in for this)

Design Goals

Spoiler
Avoid power-creeping base game colonization
Add interesting alternatives other than [build highest income industry].
Specifically avoided any conditions that produce flat commodity output that would ever exceed a base game planet with a colony item installed.
Fit seamlessly into any modded starsector experience.

AI disclaimer

Spoiler
The code and the condition icons in this mod were created by Claude, Anthropic's AI.

Changelog
1.0.0: first public release.

Source code is included and on GitHub (MIT license). Feedback and bug reports are welcome here or on GitHub.

gallery.aiCaption: A banner showing three planets with the text "ROGUE PLANETS".
A wide banner showing the mod title 'ROGUE PLANETS' alongside several colorful planets.
A dark planet with glowing orange cracks or lava flows on its surface.
A pale, cratered moon-like planet with teal patches.
A grey and brown rocky planet with a textured surface.
A gas giant planet featuring distinct purple and brown horizontal bands.
A bright white ice planet with faint surface details.
A grey planet surrounded by floating asteroids and glowing orange fissures.
An infographic titled 'NOT EVERY WORLD IS JUST A WORLD' listing various market conditions like 'Ground-to-Space Missile Defense' and 'Resonant Signal Trap'.
An infographic titled 'BUILD THE PAIR. REAP THE REWARD.' explaining the synergy system with steps and a tooltip example for 'Volatile Additive Reactor'.
